name: Theme Sync
description: Syncs the wallpaper's Material You palette live to Kitty, btop, Starship, Fastfetch, Spicetify, Fuzzel, Sonora and Dolphin, with per-app on/off toggles and configurable Dolphin opacity/blur. Requires a one-time setup script — see README.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Runs a companion systemd service (installed by scripts/install.sh) that watches ~/.cache/ambxst/colors.json and rewrites per-app config/theme files when the wallpaper's palette changes
Writes ~/.config/hypr/lua/generated/theme-sync-rice.lua and runs 'hyprctl reload' when Dolphin opacity/blur settings change
